description: This script generates C header files with macros for utility purposes such as listification, equality checks, increment/decrement, and doubling, based on a specified limit. It is part of a build or code generation process within the Zephyr project.

methods.name: write_hidden_start
methods.description: Writes the start of a hidden section comment in a header file.

methods.name: write_hidden_stop
methods.description: Writes the end of a hidden section comment in a header file.

methods.name: gen_util_listify
methods.description: Generates the util_listify.h header with macros for listification up to a given limit.

methods.name: gen_util_internal_is_eq
methods.description: Generates util_internal_is_eq.h with macros for equality checks.

methods.name: gen_util_internal_util_inc
methods.description: Generates util_internal_util_inc.h with macros for incrementing.

methods.name: gen_util_internal_util_dec
methods.description: Generates util_internal_util_dec.h with macros for decrementing.

methods.name: gen_util_internal_util_x2
methods.description: Generates util_internal_util_x2.h with macros for doubling.
